datasets.name: OUTCollatralAccs
datasets.sql:
SELECT   ac.id AS id, ac.kli_id AS custid, ac.acc_no AS accno,
         ac.NAME AS clientname, ac.val_acc
    FROM OUT_ACCOUNT ac
   WHERE
  (ac.bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                           FROM cm_aginfo
                          WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                             FROM cm_accountgroups g
                                            WHERE g.iname = 'CollateralAccs'))
         )

and  ac.kli_id in( select distinct BOOROWERID from cm_portfolio where id=:creditid)
--and ac.bal_cn1 =:balcin
ORDER BY accno,kli_id
